title: Chapter 560 - 560 Long Way To Go!
content:
Chapter 560 - 560 Long Way To Go!

Chapter 560 - 560 Long Way to Go!

560 Long Way to Go!

Lin Fan did not care about the discussions on the internet.

At this moment, a crisp bell rang outside the door.

When Lin Fan heard that, he slowly stood up and opened the door.

He saw…

The director of the Institute of Science, Feng Zhixiang, was standing at the door with a smile on his face.

He cupped his hands and said, “Professor Lin, congratulations on winning the Nobel Prize in physics, chemistry, medicine, and peace. You’ve made history in one fell swoop. Congratulations!”

Perhaps Lin Fan had heard too many similar congratulations.

Therefore, Lin Fan appeared very calm and said, “Thank you.”

Then, he said, “Come in and sit for a while.”

The smile on Feng Zhixiang’s face widened. “Haha, thanks.”

At this moment, the coffee table was filled with the rich fragrance of Spirit Tea.

It was elegant and refreshing.

Feng Zhixiang inhaled lightly, and his entire body seemed to relax a lot.

Even though Feng Zhixiang had drunk a lot of good tea, at this moment, he could not help but feel his throat go dry. He swallowed his saliva.

Lin Fan said, “If you’re thirsty, there’s a disposable cup in the drawer. You can pour it yourself.”

Feng Zhixiang did not stand on ceremony and said, “Alright.”

As he spoke, he could not wait to pour himself a cup of Spirit Tea.

After drinking the tea, he instantly felt relaxed and carefree to the extreme.

He felt like he had been trapped in the desert but suddenly drank a glass of ice water.

Therefore, Feng Zhixiang could not help but pour himself another cup of Spirit Tea.

After drinking two cups of Spirit Tea, Feng Zhixiang praised sincerely, “Good tea!”

Lin Fan said, “So, why are you here today?”

Feng Zhixiang rubbed his hands and said, “Oh, it’s like this. The controllable nuclear fusion factory should be completed today. The controllable nuclear fusion technology you mentioned last time…”

As he spoke, his face was full of anticipation.

When Lin Fan heard Feng Zhixiang’s words, his eyes lit up.

He asked in a surprised tone, “Can it be completed today?”

This was related to his mission.

Lin Fan clearly remembered that there were three tasks for this mission.

They were to build a 10,000-acre controllable nuclear fusion plant, own a Totamac device, and read four books.

Lin Fan had already completed the last two.

Now, there was only the 10,000-acre controllable nuclear fusion plant left.

It had only been two to three months since the construction of the factory was arranged.

The construction was completed so quickly?

Feng Zhixiang nodded. “Yes, strictly speaking, all the equipment has been installed. You just need to find an opportunity to cut the ribbon and you can announce the completion!”

“You didn’t cut corners, right?”

Although Lin Fan wanted to complete the mission as soon as possible, he definitely did not want to invite trouble by cutting corners just to finish the construction as soon as possible.

“Everything was built according to high standards. There’ll definitely be no quality problems!” Feng Zhixiang immediately guaranteed. “It’s just that we have more people building it, so the speed is faster.”

Lin Fan nodded in satisfaction and said, “Alright, let’s go cut the ribbon!”

“Alright!” Feng Zhixiang said.

The Audi and the Cullinan continued to drive toward the suburbs.

Not long after, a group of tall buildings appeared in front of them.

Lin Fan still remembered the first time he came here. There was only a narrow, bumpy road and a few dilapidated factories.

It had only been two months, but Youbai Road, which had eight lanes in both directions, and a large nuclear fusion plant that covered more than 10,000 acres now existed here.

Some people said that nature had the power of uncanny workmanship.

In fact, humans also possessed similar powers.

When the security guard at the entrance saw Feng Zhixiang’s and Lin Fan’s cars, he immediately stood up straight and quickly opened the gate.

When the vehicles drove into the square of the factory, all the workers gathered together and stood neatly in a square.

Obviously, they had already received Feng Zhixiang’s notice.

Under the gazes of the workers, Lin Fan and Feng Zhixiang slowly walked onto the stage.

“Thanks to the hard work of everyone, the construction of Ordinary Technology Co., Ltd. is officially completed today!” Feng Zhixiang said loudly.

The venue immediately erupted into a round of applause.

This was a congratulatory gesture, and at the same time, it was also an affirmation of their hard work over the past few months.

“Next, let’s invite Professor Lin to give a speech and cut the ribbon for the completion of Ordinary Technology Co., Ltd.!”

Hence, everyone’s gaze was focused on Lin Fan.

Lin Fan looked at everyone and said, “Ordinary Technology Co., Ltd. is completed!”

After saying that, he picked up the scissors and cut the ribbon!

All the employees were stunned.

Just one sentence and he was done?

Feng Zhixiang was the first to react. He raised his hand and clapped hard.

Then…

All the employees present also clapped.

Lin Fan’s face revealed an obvious smile.

This was not because he was happy that he had successfully cut the ribbon, signifying the completion of the factory, but because a clear notification had sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Mission completed—build a nuclear fusion plant of more than 10,000 acres (1/1), own a Totamac device (1/1), and read Particle Simulation of Plasmas, Manual of Plasma Physics and Formulas, Physics of Thermonutal Fusion Plasma, and Controlled Nuclear Fusion (5/5). Reward: Complete version of controllable nuclear fusion device, its related knowledge, physics level +1, 1 platinum packet.]

[Ding! Upgrade successful! Congratulations, you’ve gained Top Academician-Level Physics Experience.]

Suddenly, a lot of complicated physics knowledge appeared in Lin Fan’s mind. Among them, controllable nuclear fusion knowledge was the most complicated.

The applause ended.

Feng Zhixiang asked, “Professor Lin, let me show you around.”

“Alright,” Lin Fan said.

Hence, Feng Zhixiang brought Lin Fan past the towering chimney, the spacious workshop, the bright office, and the warm dormitory…

Even though they were traveling by car, it took them more than half an hour to roughly tour the entire factory.

At this moment, Feng Zhixiang’s gaze slowly landed on Lin Fan. He rubbed his hands and smiled. “Professor Lin, the construction of the factory has been completed. What about the controllable nuclear fusion…”

Lin Fan said, “I’ll go back first.”

Without waiting for Feng Zhixiang to say anything else, he turned around and got into his Cullinan. He stepped on the accelerator and sped off into the distance.

Only Feng Zhixiang was left standing on the spot in a daze.

What was going on?

Was it not said that if the controllable nuclear fusion plant was built, he would have the controllable nuclear fusion technology?

Why did he just leave?

Feng Zhixiang looked at the taillights that were getting farther and farther away. He opened his mouth, but in the end, he could not say anything.

In the end, he could only sigh deeply.

“It seems like the controllable nuclear fusion… There’s still a long way to go!” Feng Zhixiang said helplessly.
